title: A Good View
alt: Four panels in the teal office. 1: A caption reads 2:15 PM. Pip stands at the big window, where it is night with stars and a moon, and says it's two in the afternoon; Margo watches from her desk. 2: Pip asks why it's still night. Margo, deadpan behind her desk, says: Is it. 3: Close-up of Margo, eyes softer than usual, saying: It's a good view. 4: Pip stands under the window, smiling, and says: It is. Margo, beside a steaming mug, says: Stamp the folder.
hover: Pip has stopped asking what time it is.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: It's two in the afternoon.
Panel 2 – PIP: Why is it still night?
Panel 3 – MARGO: It's a good view.
note: Margo has never once said why. I checked.
